obligations.target: Verify that parameter input fields are rendered alongside API calls that accept parameters on the main landing page view.
obligations.reason: Vitest unit tests evaluate the landing page view rendering logic to ensure parameter input fields are present for parameterized endpoints.

obligations.target: Verify that executing an API call with a user-supplied parameter uses the provided value and displays the resulting response.
obligations.reason: Vitest unit tests verify the interactive API execution logic and output presentation handler with a supplied parameter value.

obligations.target: Verify that executing an API call with multiple parameters incorporates all supplied values into the request and presents the combined result.
obligations.reason: Vitest unit tests assert parameter binding and request dispatching across multiple inputs and check that the resulting data is displayed.

obligations.target: Verify that submitting an API call with missing required parameter input triggers validation messaging and halts execution.
obligations.reason: Vitest unit tests prove the client-side validation logic blocks request submission and surfaces a required-field notification when inputs are empty.

obligations.target: Verify that updating parameter values and re-triggering the API call dispatches with updated values and updates the displayed response.
obligations.reason: Vitest unit tests confirm state handling and re-execution behavior when parameter values are replaced and executed again.

obligations.target: Verify that parameter values containing special characters and spaces are correctly handled, encoded, and reflected in the response output.
obligations.reason: Vitest unit tests prove parameter sanitization and URI encoding logic when executing API calls with special characters.
